sources.entry: Katana - Katana is a simple screenshot utility for macOS that lives in your menubar.

summary.one_liner: Katana is an open-source macOS menubar screenshot utility that also uploads images and shortens links.
summary.what_it_does: Katana is a screenshot tool for macOS that runs from the menu bar rather than the Dock. According to the README, it can upload files to several image hosts, including Imgur and Pomf. Files can be sent by dragging and dropping them onto the menu bar icon. Any link copied to the clipboard can be shortened. Keyboard shortcuts and preferences are customizable. The README says downloads are on the releases page, but it does not describe a build or install process.
use_cases: drag and drop file uploads from menu bar
how_to_run: Download the app from the releases page linked in the README
notable: Lives in the menu bar and keeps the Dock uncluttered
Uploads to several image hosts, including Imgur and Pomf
Drag and drop files onto the menu bar icon to upload them
Automatically shortens links copied to the clipboard
caveats: README gives no build or source-install instructions; downloads come from the releases page
README says the app is 'constantly evolving' but gives no version or changelog details
